en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small rural town surrounded by flat, open farmland and forests in the distance. In the foreground is a prominent church with a tall spire and adjoining graveyard, with scattered houses, barns, and narrow roads around it. The landscape is largely agricultural fields divided into rectangular plots, with a straight road leading out toward the horizon. No visible printed text or caption appears on the image itself.
